question: Krang, the All-Powerful (a draw-caused trigger of ours triggers an additional time: Shabraz two counters and two life per card, Smothering Tithe, Consecrated Sphinx, Faerie Mastermind, Irencrag Pyromancer) in -- the pilot: 'this bad boys gotta make the cut' -- and for what?

contributions.text:
Study 023, Krang, the All-Powerful in: cut Inti, Seneschal of the Sun (contested). Goldfish, one instrument, 10,000 paired games, Krang's doubling NOT yet read (a 3/3 body): the rows show what each cut COSTS, not what Krang adds.

| Teferi, Master of Time | -5.7 [-7.9, -3.4] | -1.6 pts [-1.9, -1.4] | -2.5 [-2.7, -2.3] | +1.0 pts |
| Lizard Blades | -13.7 | -2.1 | — | — |
| Jace's Archivist | -27.7 | — | -2.1 | — |
1. Inti (pick): the cheapest cut and the only one that loses no cards; no Krang synergy (attack and discard triggers, not draw). Cost: the attack-discard counter and trample, and the impulse draw on a wheel; staged 2026-11-14 as a Human.
2. Willie Lumpkin: his draws feed Shabraz and the opponent's optional draw feeds Tithe — Krang doubles both.
3. Teferi, Master of Time: costs the most; its +1 draw on every player's turn is a Shabraz trigger Krang doubles.
Not ranked: Lizard Blades (load-bearing), Jace's Archivist (a wheel, the pilot's way to find Krang), Shang-Chi (draw-caused trigger, a Krang partner), Collective Defiance, Consecrated Sphinx (Krang's best partner), Gratuitous Violence (-33).
Open: the Humans as priors (Inti, Willie, Shang-Chi, Abolisher); re-screen Inti and Teferi once Krang's doubling is read.
